text: Calibration rows = the fresh S6 COMPLIANT rows (7,147 rows / 297 episodes / 297 clips; S6 is a subset of S2, every slot valid, regime defined), not the 9,135 S2 rows: the regime target needs the 5.0 / 6.0 s slots. Design defect flagged for Phase B: refcv9_progress.r9_losses teacher-forces the profile on r* even where gt_regime's `ok` is False (rows without a 6 s future), where r* is undefined.

CV score = the stage-2 objective itself (mean L1 progress over 8 slots + regime CE), pooled out-of-fold; H2cn's h2n_fit scored pooled held-out L1 only. Grid (MLP_WD x MLP_MAX_EP 200), folds (folds_of(eid, fit_seed), 5), AdamW lr 1e-3, batch 256, seeding: identical to h2n_fit.

The head IS refcv9_progress.R9ProgressHead, fitted with its BatchNorm in EVAL mode on the training rows' population mean / var (the module's own eval formula is the fitted standardisation); the in-trainer stage 2 would accumulate BN statistics in train mode (unbiased batch variances). Fitted in float64, frozen in float32 (the in-model dtype): K-RELOAD 0 decision flips, max profile difference <= 2.8e-5 m on the fit rows.

R9PF-TL shares R9PF's fitted head per fit seed (prereg s1: 'same profiles'), decision 'trunk_lon' from the battery dump's nav_true.tacv6_lon_logits (argmax over LON6 grouped to regimes); not separately fitted.

R9PF-SHUF permutation = a seeded episode derangement (rng 20261026 + fit seed; rows position-matched mod donor length); no episode keeps its own labels, but ~40 % of rows keep their class by chance (cruise is 52 %).

K-LABSRC-R9 mutation (labels from the fresh v9 lon_v7) reads RED mostly TRIVIALLY: 6,658 of 7,147 rows carry a lon_v7 id outside LON6 (unmapped); on the 489 mapped rows, 173 disagree with the kinematic target -- RED on those too.

The prereg s1 EXPLORATORY calibration-tuned decel tau was not run in A2; it was run AFTER the bars (code/x_tau_fit.py: OOF regime logits on the calibration rows, the head's own wd / epochs and folds; tau = max Youden J for decel, ties -> larger tau; fs0/1/2 tau = 0.25 / 0.29 / 0.28) and is reported BESIDE only (result/R9PF_X_ATTRIB.json, arm TAU). It never enters a bar.
Clip ids were printed ONCE to this agent's own terminal output while inspecting windows_s1.json's format; no file written by this run contains a raw clip id (sha12 only).

The R9 code = a COPY of the patch's base tree 425762053c75 (== tip for refc_v3.py) + the banked patch (4b5f7fb; patch blob 0a165b98 verified; reverse dry-run clean on the copy); the K-EQ launch tree = that stack + taniteval@425762053c75 + the refcv7 battery code (identical tree in fb47a58).

SUPERSEDED by AMENDMENT1 change 4: the PRIMARY eval path is the battery tree's BANKED fb47a58 plan (refcv6_extras nav_true.traj; bit-equal to the plan8 inside H2CN_DEPLOY8 and RETIME_DEPLOY8 at both seeds, K-INPUTS). The eval bank's traj_own equals it bit for bit at seed 1 but differs at seed 0 on 4,630 / 4,754 S2 windows (max 35.31 m); R9 compositions on traj_own are banked beside (*_own arrays). FACTORED_DEPLOY8's plan8 equals NEITHER path at either seed (it is the factored decoder's own native path), so PA-1b compares two decoders on their own paths, as the sealed s1 defines FACTORED_DEPLOY8. The OSONLY beside arm = the battery plan without re-timing.

PA-2 read as the CONJUNCTION (conservative): paired ADE vs RETIME_DEPLOY8 separated below on S2 AND S6 compliant, AND the SHIP-R8 E1 / E3 form (vs ha0_ext_pose) separated below, at both inference seeds.

K-CONSTZ read conservatively: R9PF-CONSTZ passing PA-1a OR PA-1b at ANY fit seed voids the run. PA-G is binding on the primary R9PF_fs0 (PA-R names only 1a / 1b / 2); fs1 / fs2 PA-G are reported beside.
PA-G's exceedance = the registered compliance-row rule (planned_max_speed of the FULL 8-slot plan > the fed ceiling, strict) on all 4,754 windows, paired per window vs H2CN_DEPLOY8.

SUPERSEDED by AMENDMENT1 changes 2 / 3: K-OFF = flags-ON vs flags-OFF on ONE tree (tip + R9 patch + the pinned one-line RNG fix, F:/refcv9_r9pf_scratch/launch_tree_fix) at inference seeds 0 AND 1; K-EQ = same-input form at seeds 0 AND 1 (both required -- the conservative reading; the amendment names seeds only for K-OFF). Subset = the first clips in sha12 order until >= 500 windows of the battery's windows_s{seed}.json, filtered in memory; the tip loader's pose-sync shift is blanked under R8_NO_POSE_SYNC=1 and asserted not attached. 'Every non-R9 output' = every tensor the model returns per call (sha256 of bytes + dtype + shape, all rows and conditions, nav-null calls included); the K-EQ same inputs = the forward's own traj_preretime, z_tac (lat_head_tac input) and r9_x, plus the scoring prior8 (s_prior agreement reported).

PRE-GO diagnostics on the CALIBRATION split (70 fresh windows; not eval139): tip tree without R9 != fb47a58 bank plan on 70/70 (max 7.24 m; z bit-equal; deterministic run-to-run); R9 build reseeds CUDA RNG (torch.manual_seed inside fork_rng(devices=[])) -> path moves on 70/70 (max 8.10 m); one-line fix (torch.default_generator.manual_seed) restores flags-on == flags-off bit for bit; same-input K-EQ 1.53e-5 m (1 float32 ULP at 128-256 m) -- escalated to the MM before GO.

ONE composition per window: the S6 compliant rows are a subset of the S2 rows, and the S6 arm := the S2 composition indexed to those windows (every S6 input asserted bit-equal to its S2 row). A separate S6-batch composition differs from the S2-batch one by float32 batch-order rounding only -- 7 / 3,668 rows, <= 7.63e-6 m, 0 decision flips (R9PF_COMPOSE.json, K-S6CONSIST 'separate_batch_composition_beside').

The R9 RNG fix (AMENDMENT1 change 1) is a byte-exact one-line replacement at refc_v3.py line 2125 (CRLF preserved; code/FIX_R9_RNG.DIFF.txt; the fixed file, the diff, the unchanged refcv9_progress.py and the unfixed reference are pinned in FIX_R9_RNG.sha256). An earlier sed attempt converted the file's line endings and was discarded unused; the pinned file is the byte-clean one. Every a3 script re-hashes the amendment seal and every FIX_R9_RNG.sha256 line and refuses otherwise.

Process note: two shell commands in this run fed a heredoc AND '</dev/null' to python; on Windows NUL is a console device, so python opened an interactive REPL that looped on an invalid handle (~64 MB of error text into the harness's own output file). Both processes were stopped by their task; neither wrote any file in the work dir or scratch, and both edits were re-applied from patch files.

EXPLORATORY post-bar attribution (code/x_attrib_r9pf.py -> result/R9PF_X_ATTRIB.json; NOT a bar, NOT pre-registered): arms ORACLE (GT regime + R9 profiles; inadmissible), CRUISE, TAU, SOFT (posterior-weighted profile), HYB (R9 decision gating H2CN_DEPLOY8). Run under RULE ZERO to rank the next lever; every number there is labelled EXPLORATORY and none changes the verdict.

K-OFF: `wp_seq` differs ON vs OFF on 515/515 calls at both seeds because it IS the emitted plan (refc_v3.py:2742 out['wp_seq'] = traj, set after the R9 re-time at :2723). The compare first read it as a non-R9 output (K-OFF FAIL), then classified it as a plan alias from data -- digest(wp_seq) == digest(traj) on every call of both runs -- and checks it like traj (ON traj_preretime == OFF wp_seq: 0 / 515 differ). No other output differs. K-OFF then PASSES at both seeds. Disclosed because the classification was made after seeing the first result.

K-EQ FAILS as written at both seeds: decision agreement 100 % (515/515), but max |d| 3.05e-5 / 4.58e-5 m exceeds 2 ulp_float32 of the window's own max |coordinate| on 28 / 24 of 515 windows (max ratio 13). The stricter reading of the coordinate scope was used (the brief: conservative on ambiguity). BESIDE, not registered: the residual survives the forward's OWN s_prior (17 / 19 windows over) and a tolerance that includes the prior's coordinates (26 / 22 over), so it is not the prior. Unresolved: GPU-vs-CPU arithmetic in the head is the candidate (the in-forward head runs on CUDA, the offline one on CPU); the discriminating test is the same roll on CPU, which was not run.
